dedupe_keys.name: gcam usa residential energy consumption by income group under ira decarbonisation scenarios

description: This Zenodo dataset from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory gives projections of residential energy consumption split by income group under decarbonisation scenarios, produced with GCAM-USA for the Grid Operations, Decarbonization, Environmental and Energy Equity Platform (GODEEEP) investment. It updates an earlier version by implementing the Inflation Reduction Act in the model scenarios. GCAM-USA is the version of the Global Change Analysis Model with the United States resolved into the 50 states and the District of Columbia inside 32 world regions; it solves all markets for equilibrium at each time step. The record holds post-processed key residential output variables as CSV tables and the full model output databases so that users can query other outputs. Coverage: US states and the District of Columbia, by income group. Access: one ZIP file of about 3.9 GB on Zenodo, version 1.0.0 of 2023-09-25. Licence: CC0 1.0; free. Caveats: these are integrated assessment model projections under stated assumptions, not observed consumption, and reading the databases needs GCAM tools. Simulation uses are equity-aware residential demand scenarios for grid and building stock studies. Related records: the energy piece's GCAM-USA scenarios for GODEEEP record covers the twelve system-wide GODEEEP scenarios; this record is the residential multi-income subset.
